notes: Twitter v1.1-style Tweet objects, one JSON object per line. created_at uses the Twitter date string in UTC. id_str is the canonical id. Text is in full_text. Retweets carry retweeted_status (id, time and author of the original) and 'RT @author: text'; quotes carry quoted_status_id_str and a link; replies carry in_reply_to_* fields. entities.urls[].expanded_url holds the real destination of each t.co link.

tweet_object.name: source
tweet_object.notes: posting client, as an HTML anchor

tweet_object.name: entities
tweet_object.notes: hashtags, user_mentions (screen_name, id_str), urls (url, expanded_url, display_url)

tweet_object.name: retweeted_status
tweet_object.notes: id_str, created_at and user of the original

tweet_object.name: retweet_count / favorite_count
tweet_object.notes: platform-wide counts at collection; larger than the retweets present in this collection

tweet_object.name: coordinates / place
tweet_object.notes: GeoJSON point (longitude, latitude) on about one post in a hundred; always on land

user_object.name: followers_count / friends_count / statuses_count
user_object.notes: at the time of the post; they drift

entities_object.name: hashtags
entities_object.notes: text excludes #; indices are char positions in text

entities_object.name: media
entities_object.notes: Only present if tweet has media

join_keys.user.screen_name: personas.json personas[].handle without the @ (or accounts_compact rows)
join_keys.entities.urls.expanded_url: outlet story links follow https://<outlet site>/<YYYY>/<MM>/<DD>/<slug>, the same pattern as the news feeds

coverage.notes: Automated relay accounts start with their sensor archives on 2027-08-15 and are silent when the sensor is. Local accounts post far less from landfall until power and cell service return.

naming: The utility appears as Coastal Bend Power and Water Authority or CBPWA (@CBPWA_Alerts). Outlets post as @BaysideLedger, @Harborline6News, @CoastlinePublicRadio, @GulfwaterMaritime, @SabalEnergyWire, @ContinentalWire, @AnchorRotorWeekly, @KNCB1480.

files.<handle>.jsonl: every post by one account listed under personas in personas.json (309 files)
files.community_<YYYY-MM>.jsonl: posts by the accounts listed under accounts_compact, grouped by month of posting (UTC)
files._account_lookup.jsonl: users/lookup snapshot taken at the end of the collection (2028-01-12): the user object, or error code 63 'User has been suspended.'
files._platform_records_return.jsonl: account access records returned by the platforms on 2027-10-14 under a law-enforcement referral: post-creation events with source address and autonomous system
files._geotagged_index.csv: index of geo-tagged posts for convenience: id_str, screen_name, created_utc, latitude, longitude

generator: scripts/streams/gen_social.py with social_text.py and social_script.py (deterministic); probes in scripts/streams/probes_social_finance.py

additional_fields.truncated: always false; full_text carries the whole post
additional_fields.place.place_type: place object type when a post is geo-tagged (city, neighborhood, poi)
additional_fields.place.full_name: display name of the tagged place
